The given query can be optimized by reducing the number of subqueries and using window functions to calculate the year total for each customer within a single query. Here's the rewritten version:

```sql
WITH year_total AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_login,
        c.c_email_address,
        d.d_year,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_id ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS year_total,
        's' AS sale_type
    FROM
        customer c
        JOIN store_sales ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_login,
        c.c_email_address,
        d.d_year,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_id ORDER BY d.d_year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS year_total,
        'w' AS sale_type
    FROM
        customer c
        JOIN web_sales ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
),
year_ratio AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        customer_first_name,
        customer_last_name,
        customer_email_address,
        CASE WHEN year_total > 0 THEN year_total[1] / year_total[2] ELSE 0.0 END AS ratio
    FROM
        year_total
    LATERAL JOIN UNNEST(array_agg(year_total ORDER BY d_year)) WITH ORDINALITY AS year_total(year, rank)
    WHERE
        rank = 1 AND year >= 1998 AND year <= 1998 + 1
)
SELECT * FROM year_ratio ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 100
```

This version calculates the year total for each customer using window functions, eliminating the need for multiple subqueries. It also uses a lateral join to unnest the array of year totals and calculate the ratio between the first and second years (1998 and 1999).
